title: Mask Adoption Simulation Task
description: Develop a mask-wearing adoption simulator that jointly models behavioural decisions and information diffusion on a multiplex social network. The simulator should infer peer influence, risk sensitivity, broadcast intensity, and memory decay parameters from observed agent-level trajectories, matching daily mask-wearing trends and transition dynamics.
simulation_focus: Fit decision and information propagation parameters using simulation-based inference (SBI) or evolutionary optimisation
Represent multiplex social influence via family, work/school, and community layers with heterogeneous edge weights
Track information memory and broadcast effects to capture non-pharmaceutical interventions
Evaluate fit using RMSE/MAE of daily rates, Wasserstein distance on distributions, and transition probability errors
Support counterfactual experiments (e.g., stronger broadcast, altered peer influence, changed network density)

data_files.train_data.csv: 30 days × 100 agents. Columns: day, agent_id, wearing_mask, received_info. Used for calibration.
data_files.val_data.csv: 5-day holdout (days 30-34) with identical schema for early stopping and validation.
data_files.test_data.csv: 10-day evaluation window (days 30-39) for final fit and stress testing.
data_files.agent_attributes.csv: Static metadata per agent: age_group (categorical), occupation (categorical), risk_perception (float).
data_files.social_network.json: Multiplex adjacency lists for family/work_school/community layers (agent_id → neighbours).
data_files.metadata.json: Dataset level notes (train/val/test day ranges, seeds, broadcast intervention day).

RMSE_daily_rate.description: Root Mean Squared Error between simulated and observed daily mask-wearing rates (validation/test).

MAE_daily_rate.description: Mean Absolute Error of daily mask-wearing rates.

TransitionFit.description: Average absolute error across transition probabilities (P01, P11, P10, P00).

Wasserstein_distribution.description: 1-Wasserstein distance between simulated and observed distributions (aggregate rates or agent samples).

Broadcast_memory_accuracy.description: Optional: MAE between simulated information memory and observed received_info share.

overall_simulation_design.objective: Infer parameters governing information diffusion and behavioural adoption (peer weights, broadcast intensity, memory decay, risk sensitivity, temperature).
overall_simulation_design.initialization: Initial states extracted from day 0 of train_data.csv; memory initialised from received_info column. Neighbour shares pre-computed per layer using social_network.json.
overall_simulation_design.execution: Calibrate parameters via SBI (posterior sampling) or evolutionary search. For each candidate parameter set, roll out simulator with observed network and broadcast schedule, compute losses on train window, validate on days 30-34.
outputs: Calibrated parameter vector theta_hat with layer weights and broadcast terms
Validation metrics (RMSE, MAE, transition fit, optional Wasserstein)

agent_archetypes.construction_from_data: Join agent_attributes.csv with train/val/test trajectories by agent_id.

interaction_topology.construction_from_data: Neighbours read from social_network.json (list of ids per layer).

holdout_plan.notes: Use temporal holdout; avoid leakage across splits.
